verdict.rationale: Navan provides a documented public API (developer.navan.com) with OAuth 2.0 client-credentials auth, retrieval/update endpoints across expense, card, payroll, custom fields, and webhooks, plus a first-party MCP server for natural-language AI access — corroborated by a live llms.txt probe. Missing for 10: independent third-party developer accounts of building against the API and clearer rate-limit/versioning documentation.
